powershell7.title: PowerShell 7 is recommended

powershell7.restartHint: If a new installation is still not detected, fully quit and reopen WebCodex to refresh its process environment.

extensions.title: Extensions & instructions
permissions.owner: Computer Use executes in Runner. These native probes and requests apply to Desktop only. macOS may assign permission to Runner or its responsible app; a Desktop grant does not prove Runner access.
permissions.restartHelp: Denial is respected. After changing permissions, restart the actual permission owner if macOS asks, then retry the Runner operation. Runner-only restart is available in Extensions.
permissions.error: Permission request unavailable. Check system privacy settings.
plugins.help: Register a trusted native Tool Plugin on this Runner. Saving does not launch it; restart Runner to apply. Existing registrations are never overwritten.
plugins.name: Display name
plugins.argsHelp: Use an array of strings, such as ["/absolute/path/plugin.js"]. Arguments clear after submission. Use configuration profiles for credentials.
plugins.invalidArgs: Enter a JSON array containing only strings.
tunnelConfig.applyFailed: Configuration saved, but the Tunnel needs recovery. Retry the connection; Server and Runner were not restarted.
setup.initialProjectHelp: Choose a folder to register now, or continue without a project. Runner stays enabled either way.

setup.runnerNameHelp: A label to recognize this computer in ChatGPT. Up to 200 characters; the Runner ID stays unchanged.

completion.confirm: I saw the file contents in ChatGPT
completion.reported: You reported a successful read. This is your confirmation, not an automatically observed connection test.
completion.identityPending: Runner identity is not available yet. Refresh the environment before trying the read.
